metadata.intro: Welcome to the Philosophy of Physics gateway. This roadmap connects the epistemological foundations of physical theories to the ontological nature of space, time, and quantum mechanics.

pillars.title: 1. Scientific Realism & The Nature of Laws
pillars.narrative: Explores the ontological commitments of physics, the debate between realism and instrumentalism, and the metaphysical status of natural laws.

pillars.title: 2. The Ontology of Space and Time
pillars.narrative: Investigates the absolute versus relational debate, the substantival nature of the spacetime manifold, and the cosmological arrow of time.

pillars.title: 3. Philosophical Foundations of Quantum Mechanics
pillars.narrative: Analyzes the measurement problem, the role of the observer, and the ontological implications of various quantum interpretations.

pillars.title: 4. Causality, Symmetries, and Conservation
pillars.narrative: Examines the conceptual underpinnings of physical causation, the necessity of symmetries, and the philosophical interpretation of conservation laws.
